title: brand-guidelines part 2/3: dos/don'ts CRUD + manual content-check screen
description:
Operator dispatch (msg-zf8te2eqb3z4). Part 2 of brand-guidelines app, building on part 1 (brand profiles, voice, visual identity already merged).

Scope:
1. DosAndDonts entries per brand profile. Fields: type (do | don't), category (tone | vocabulary | visuals | legal | campaign-messaging), title, body, optional suggestedCorrection. CRUD for non-technical users.
2. UI groups entries by category and by do/don't.
3. Manual content-check screen: brand manager pastes text and picks a category (or 'all'); screen lists all dos/don'ts for the active brand matching that category. No NLP, no AI, no scoring — placeholder for part 3.
4. Voice, visual identity, dos/don'ts, content-check screen all remain visually separate.

Constraints:
- Preserve Keycloak + oauth2-proxy + RS256/JWKS exactly. Do not modify /login, /register, OAUTH_*, auth/proxy.
- Additive schema only. Part 1 data must remain valid.
- suggestedCorrection is plain text from the user — no AI-gen hooks, no pretend understanding.

Acceptance:
- Brand manager can add/edit/delete dos/don'ts categorised by topic for active brand.
- Content-check screen accepts pasted text + category and returns matching dos/don'ts for active brand.
- Part 1 functionality unchanged.

Out of scope: cross-section search, version history, agent retrieval API, real content validation, automated scoring. Those land in part 3.
